question: Bhanu ______ is a festival dedicated to the worship of the Sun God.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saptami.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhanu Saptami**__** **

 
 
• It is devoted to the Lord Surya (Sun God).</
